author: bardic-inspiration
name: Aegis of the Unbroken Gate
summary: A shield that turns ruin aside and ends a spell in your face.
description: Wrought for the last defender of a vanished citadel. A single scar runs across its face, and it never grows dull.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wielding this shield (in addition to the shield's normal bonus). You have Advantage on saving throws against spells. As a Reaction when you are the target of a spell of 5th level or lower, you can cast *Counterspell* at 3rd level from it. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
